question: Estimate the impressions of a Google Search campaign for 'best running shoes' targeted at India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Search ads (top of SERP) for the keyword cluster around 'running shoes'? Yes.
Daily impressions for a top advertiser bidding at top-of-page? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Search volume × ad coverage × top-bidder share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: India monthly search volume for 'running shoes' + close variants ('running shoes for men', 'best Nike running shoes' etc.): ~25 lakh searches/month.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Search results show 3-4 ads at top; impression share for #1 advertiser: ~60% of commercial searches = 12 lakh impressions/month.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily budget needed: ~₹70K-90K for top position.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, queries with commercial intent (shopping/research)
Search results show 3-4 ads at top; impression share for #1 advertiser
Average CTR for top ad in shopping queries
Average CPC for this keyword cluster

calculationFlow: India monthly search volume for 'running shoes' + close variants ('running shoes for men', 'best Nike running shoes' etc.): ~25 lakh searches/month.
Of these, queries with commercial intent (shopping/research): ~80% = 20 lakh.
Search results show 3-4 ads at top; impression share for #1 advertiser: ~60% of commercial searches = 12 lakh impressions/month.
Average CPC for this keyword cluster: ~₹15-25.
Daily budget needed: ~₹70K-90K for top position.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Daily budget needed: ~₹70K-90K for top position.
